title: UDLF deployment config — Splunk Enterprise Security
description: Config for `platform: splunk-es`. Splunk Enterprise Security via a deployer-built app: notable events and risk-based alerting. Accepts both the classic and ES8 findings risk shapes.

schema.description: Sub-schema revision this block was authored against, e.g. `splunk-es::0.2.0`.

severity.description: Severity for this deployment. Optional, overrides `detection_context.severity`. Maps to `action.notable.param.severity`.

schedule.description: When the saved search runs. Supply exactly one of `cron` or `frequency`.

cron.description: Cron expression for the search. Maps to `cron_schedule`.

frequency.description: Recurring interval, expanded to cron by the deployer. Splunk allows 1-59m, 1-23h or 1-30d; use `cron` for anything else.

lookback.description: Start of the search window, as a Splunk relative-time modifier. Maps to `dispatch.earliest_time`.

latest_time.description: End of the search window, as a Splunk relative-time modifier. Maps to `dispatch.latest_time`.

schedule_window.description: How far the scheduler may delay this search to reduce contention. Maps to `schedule_window`.

suppression.description: Alert throttling: discard repeat alerts sharing the same `fields` values within `window`. Maps to `alert.suppress.*`. Not `notable.nes_fields`.

fields.description: Fields whose matching values identify a duplicate alert. Each must be produced by the search.

items.description: A field name. No spaces: the conf value is comma-delimited and unquoted.

window.description: How long duplicate alerts are suppressed. Maps to `alert.suppress.period`.

threshold.description: Events that must be exceeded within the search window before the alert fires. 0 fires on any result.

notable.description: Notable-event config, emitted as `action.notable.*`. Presence of this block is what makes the deployment alerting.

rule_title.description: Notable event title. Supports `$field$` substitution. Maps to `action.notable.param.rule_title`.
examples: New abnormal credential added to Azure AD by $user$

rule_description.description: Notable event description. Supports `$field$` substitution. Maps to `action.notable.param.rule_description`.

entities.description: Alert subjects this notable is attributed to. Maps to `action.notable.param._entities`. Scored via the notable action, so they do not repeat under `rba.risk_objects`.

type.description: Category of the risk entity. Restricted to the ES8 standard of system, user, other, or N/A. `N/A` marks the absence of an entity.

score.description: Risk contributed by this entity when the notable fires. Maps to `risk_score`. `0` on the `N/A` placeholder row.

nes_fields.description: Notable Event Suppression fields ES offers analysts. Maps to `action.notable.param.nes_fields`. Not `suppression.fields`.

security_domain.description: ES categorisation of the notable event. Maps to `action.notable.param.security_domain`.

rba.description: Risk-Based Alerting. Scores entities so ES can aggregate risk over time. Emitted as `action.risk.param._risk`. `rba` without `notable` contributes risk without alerting.

message.description: Risk message for the detection as a whole. Supports `$field$` substitution. Maps to `action.risk.param._risk_message`. Supply this or a per-object message.

risk_objects.description: Entities that accrue risk. `score` is per risk object, not per detection.

field.description: Search field holding the risk object's identifier. Must be produced by the search. Maps to `risk_object_field`.

type.description: Category of the risk object. Restricted to system, user or other. No `N/A` here; an empty list means nothing to score.

score.description: Risk contributed each time the detection fires, before risk factors. Maps to `risk_score`. contentctl narrows this to 1-100.

risk_message.description: Message for this risk object alone, in the ES8 findings shape. Serialised as `risk_message` inside `_risk`.

threat_objects.description: Indicators associated with the risk event. Tracked across risk objects rather than scored.

field.description: Search field holding the threat object's value. Must be produced by the search. Maps to `threat_object_field`.

type.description: Category of the threat object. Maps to `threat_object_type`. Accepts both the Splunk RBA list (`ip`) and contentctl's (`ip_address`). Do not rewrite between them.

allOf.$comment: A risk annotation with no message at all is not useful: ES renders an empty risk event. So a block carrying risk objects must supply either a block-level message (the older shape) or a risk_message on every risk object (the ES8 findings shape). A block carrying only threat objects — which an ES8 detection whose alert subject lives in notable.entities produces — needs neither.

drilldown_searches.description: Secondary searches surfaced alongside the notable for triage. Emitted as `action.notable.param.drilldown_*`.

name.description: Label shown to the analyst. Supports `$field$` token substitution.

search.description: Drilldown SPL. Supports `$field$` token substitution from the notable.

earliest_offset.description: Start of the drilldown's search window. Commonly `$info_min_time$`, the notable's own window start.

latest_offset.description: End of the drilldown's search window. Commonly `$info_max_time$`.

advanced.description: Escape hatch for unmodelled savedsearches.conf keys. Passed through verbatim and unvalidated; prefer a modelled field.
